method: Every figure is a mean over the upazila's cropland on a 1 km grid, each cell weighted by the cropland inside it (research/grid/build.py). Context beside the 25-season replay, not a score.

sources.cropland: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m (cropland, water and built-up shares on a 100 m grid)
sources.ndviBaseline: NASA MOD13A2.061 Terra MODIS 1 km 16-day NDVI, pixel reliability 0-1, 2000-12-18 to 2026-09-30
sources.ndviNow: NASA VJ113A2.002 NOAA-20 VIIRS 1 km 16-day NDVI, reliability 0-3, 2022-12-19 to 2026-10-08, on the MODIS scale
sources.stress: NASA ECOSTRESS ECO_L4T_ESI.002 evaporative stress index, 70 m, daytime passes, March-April 2025 and 2026
sources.soil: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 250 m: sand, clay, organic carbon 0-30 cm; Saxton & Rawls (2006) available water

now.trend: each year's value on these days, a straight-line trend through the 25 years taken out

cropsByYear.note: agricultural years November-October, each labelled by the year it starts
